ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD

A downloadable game for Windows

PLAYABLE TEASER

This is a playable teaser for ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD.

Explore a small part of the game before release and discover a hidden secret.

FIND THE SECRET — ENTER THE STEAM KEY GIVEAWAY

Players who find the secret will be able to take part in a Steam key giveaway for the full version of the game.

The giveaway instructions are hidden somewhere inside the teaser.

Wishlist ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD on Steam



ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD is a first-person psychological horror game set in a roadside minimarket. This is not a typical store simulator: everyday work routines are part of the story and atmosphere.


Do you believe that on Halloween night, the line between the world of the living and the dead becomes thinner? If not, then you’re probably used to simply buying children off with candy. But imagine being stuck on a night shift in an ordinary roadside minimarket. The creatures that come to you this night are not looking for sweets. They emerge from the darkness only once a year to remind you that on this night, the doors open not only for the living. And if they have chosen you for their game… refusing is no longer possible.



Game Features:

  • Slow-burn horror focused on atmosphere and story
  • Comic-inspired visual style
  • Adjustable pixelation
  • Atmospheric sound design

georgiadion212 days ago(+2)

Felt a bit like a chore simulator based on what we were shown so far. It also didn’t really show much, so I have no idea what I’m actually signing up for.

Your page says “no generative ai was used”, but there was, and that isn’t something I’d like to support. I’d have more respect for the project if you drew it yourself, or even photobashed it. AI-generated content will probably turn people away from your game, so it’s something I would definitely recommend removing.

I am a really big fan of the graphics, they’re my favourite part of the game, along with the platformer minigame.

I look forward to seeing what you do with this game.

Reply
EMIKA_GAMES12 days ago(+2)

Thanks for the detailed feedback. I actually agree with you about the AI-generated comic image. I’m not a fan of generative AI either — I only used it as a temporary placeholder because I needed something there while working on the teaser. I wasn’t happy with that part myself.

My wife is already drawing a completely new comic in the same kind of style we used in Pieces of Me, so the current version will be replaced. On that point, I completely agree with you.

As for the routine and slower gameplay — yes, that part is intentional. This is another experimental project for me, and I definitely want to make it in my own style. The slower pace, ordinary tasks and gradual buildup are a big part of what I’m trying to do with it. At the same time, I understand that the teaser doesn’t show the full picture yet.

I’m developing the project on my own, so unfortunately I simply don’t have enough time to polish and show everything at once. I’m still figuring some things out as I go.

I’m really glad you liked the visual style — I like it a lot too.
